description: The semantic-stage half of `core-language/scoping/a-handler-body-temporary-dies-at-the-bracket`. A deferred handler block reads through a different chain than an eager block — it may see a binding the enclosing scope creates AFTER the registration (spec/execution-model.md:401-403) — so the checker's handling of it is separate code from the `repeat`/`if`/`while` path, and the outward direction it must still reject is this one: a name the handler body itself binds is not visible to the enclosing scope at any time (spec/execution-model.md:603-605, spec/error-model.md:102).
